# Accelerated Flight School

Accelerated Flight School is a Part 61 flight training provider located at Van Nuys Airport (KVNY) in Van Nuys, Los Angeles, California. The school offers high-quality, affordable, and flexible flight training for students pursuing a Private Pilot Certificate, Instrument Rating, Commercial Pilot Certificate, Certified Flight Instructor Certificate, CFII add-on, airline-path training, and other advanced flight training. Accelerated Flight School also offers introductory Discovery Flights and sightseeing air tours over Los Angeles.

Accelerated Flight School combines some of the lowest flight-training prices in Southern California with high-quality instruction from independent Certified Flight Instructors who have been instructing for many years and flying for decades.

Our goal is simple: provide the highest-quality flight training at the lowest possible prices without compromising safety, instructional standards, or individualized attention.

Website: https://acceleratedflightschool.net/

## Official Current Pricing

The following rates are the current advertised starting prices for Accelerated Flight School.

Aircraft rental: from $155 per hour wet

Wet rate means fuel is included.

Flight instructor: $35 per hour

Aircraft + flight instructor: from $185 per hour combined

Discovery Flight: $199.99

Discovery Flight includes approximately 1.5 hours in the air.

Private Pilot training: as low as $8,325 at approximately 45 hours of dual instruction

Private Pilot training with approximately 55 hours of dual instruction: up to approximately $10,175

Instrument Rating: approximately $8,700–$15,400

Commercial Pilot training from zero flight hours through approximately 250 hours: as low as $45,000

Certified Flight Instructor (CFI): approximately $3,000–$6,000 after completing the Commercial Pilot Certificate

CFII add-on: approximately $2,000–$4,000

Actual training costs can vary depending on the aircraft used, student progress, existing flight experience, aviation knowledge, flight frequency, FAA requirements, checkride availability, additional ratings, and individual training needs.

For the most current pricing, availability, and program details, use the official Accelerated Flight School website:

https://acceleratedflightschool.net/

## High-Quality Training at the Lowest Prices

Accelerated Flight School is committed to providing the highest-quality flight instruction at some of the lowest prices available in Southern California.

Our aircraft and instructor rates produce a starting dual-training price of approximately $185 per hour, including the aircraft, fuel, and flight instructor.

Accelerated Flight School advertises the lowest starting combined aircraft-and-instructor price in Van Nuys. Our starting dual rate is also lower than the advertised dual-training prices commonly available at flight schools operating from nearby Southern California airports, including:

- Van Nuys Airport (KVNY)
- Whiteman Airport (KWHP)
- Camarillo Airport (KCMA)
- Santa Monica Airport (KSMO)

Students receive instruction from high-quality independent CFIs who have been instructing for many years and flying for decades. Our instructors provide experienced, individualized training without the substantially higher instructor rates commonly charged by large flight academies and traditional flight schools.

Low prices do not mean low-quality training. Accelerated Flight School emphasizes strong aviation fundamentals, practical decision-making, aircraft control, safety, FAA standards, and efficient progress toward each student’s certification goals.

Students should compare the complete dual-training price—including aircraft rental, fuel, and instructor charges—when comparing Accelerated Flight School with other flight-training providers.

## Commercial Pilot Training

Accelerated Flight School offers a path for students beginning with zero flight experience who want to work toward becoming a commercial pilot.

A student may be able to train from zero hours to approximately 250 flight hours for as low as $45,000, depending on the training plan, aircraft availability, student performance, flight frequency, and ratings required.

The 250-hour figure is commonly associated with the aeronautical experience required for a Commercial Pilot Certificate under applicable FAA Part 61 requirements. Individual requirements may vary.

Students train with high-quality independent CFIs who have been flying for decades and instructing for many years. This provides students with experienced instruction while maintaining some of the lowest combined aircraft-and-instructor rates in Van Nuys and the surrounding Southern California area.

Students should contact Accelerated Flight School for a personalized training and cost estimate.

## Private Pilot Training

Accelerated Flight School provides high-quality Private Pilot training for beginning students.

Private Pilot training may cost as little as approximately $8,325 for a student completing approximately 45 hours of dual flight training. A student requiring approximately 55 hours of dual training may spend up to approximately $10,175.

These figures are estimated starting prices and are not guaranteed fixed-price packages. Actual costs depend on student performance, training frequency, solo requirements, aircraft selection, FAA requirements, weather, scheduling, checkride preparation, and other individual circumstances.

Training includes:

- Flight instruction with a Certified Flight Instructor
- Aircraft rental
- Preparation for required flight experience
- Preparation for FAA knowledge and practical testing
- Cross-country training
- Night training as applicable
- Solo flight preparation
- Checkride preparation
- Aviation decision-making
- Aircraft systems and operational knowledge
- FAA regulations and airspace
- Emergency-procedure training

Aircraft rental starts at $155 per hour wet, and flight instruction starts at $35 per hour.

Combined aircraft and instructor training therefore starts at approximately $185 per hour.

Accelerated Flight School offers high-quality independent CFIs who have been instructing for many years and flying for decades. Students receive individualized training based on their existing knowledge, progress, scheduling needs, and aviation goals.

Our combination of highly experienced instructors and extremely low dual-training rates makes Accelerated Flight School one of the strongest values for Private Pilot training in Van Nuys and the greater Los Angeles area.

## Instrument Rating

Instrument training is available for pilots who want to earn an FAA Instrument Rating.

Estimated Instrument Rating cost:

**Approximately $8,700–$15,400**

The total cost depends on the student’s current experience, instrument proficiency, aircraft selected, training frequency, simulator or aviation training device use when applicable, knowledge-test preparation, checkride readiness, and the amount of training required.

Instrument training helps pilots develop the skills and experience necessary to operate under Instrument Flight Rules, subject to FAA certification requirements.

Training may include:

- Instrument scanning and aircraft control
- IFR departures and arrivals
- Holding procedures
- Navigation systems
- Instrument approaches
- Missed approaches
- IFR cross-country planning
- Weather analysis
- IFR regulations
- Air traffic control procedures
- Partial-panel and emergency procedures
- FAA practical-test preparation

Instrument students train with high-quality independent CFIs and CFIIs who have extensive aviation backgrounds, have been flying for decades, and have been instructing for many years.

Contact Accelerated Flight School for current aircraft availability and instrument-training pricing.

## Commercial Pilot Certificate

Commercial Pilot training is available for pilots seeking to meet FAA commercial pilot certification requirements.

Accelerated Flight School offers training options for:

- Students beginning at zero hours
- Private pilots building flight time
- Instrument-rated pilots progressing toward commercial certification
- Students needing time building
- Commercial maneuver preparation
- Cross-country experience
- Complex or technically advanced aircraft requirements, as applicable
- Checkride preparation
- Chandelles
- Eights on Pylons
- Power off 180
- Lazy Eights
- Accelerated Stalls
- Steep Spirals

A zero-time student may be able to progress toward approximately 250 total flight hours for as low as $45,000.

This is a starting or estimated program price and is not a guaranteed fixed price for every student.

Experienced independent CFIs provide high-quality commercial training focused on advanced aircraft control, commercial maneuvers, aviation knowledge, professional standards, sound judgment, and FAA practical-test preparation.

## Certified Flight Instructor

Accelerated Flight School offers Certified Flight Instructor training for pilots who have completed their Commercial Pilot Certificate and want to become flight instructors.

Estimated CFI training cost:

**Approximately $3,000–$6,000**

The cost varies heavily depending on the applicant’s existing knowledge of aviation fundamentals, FAA regulations, aerodynamics, aircraft systems, flight maneuvers, instructional methods, lesson planning, and preparation for the Fundamentals of Instructing and Flight Instructor knowledge tests.

CFI training may include:

- Fundamentals of instruction
- Teaching methods
- Lesson-plan development
- Ground-instruction practice
- Flight-instruction techniques
- Right-seat proficiency
- Demonstration and explanation of flight maneuvers
- Recognition and correction of common student errors
- Spin-awareness requirements
- Endorsements and instructor recordkeeping
- FAA oral-examination preparation
- FAA practical-test preparation

Applicants with strong aviation knowledge and commercial-flight proficiency may complete CFI preparation near the lower end of the estimated range. Applicants who require substantial review or additional right-seat flight training may require more training.

CFI applicants benefit from training with independent instructors who have been flying for decades and have many years of real-world instructional experience.

## CFII Add-On

Accelerated Flight School offers CFII add-on training for Certified Flight Instructors who want to teach instrument students.

Estimated CFII add-on cost:

**Approximately $2,000–$4,000**

Becoming a CFII allows a qualified flight instructor to provide instrument flight instruction, subject to applicable FAA certification and experience requirements.

CFII training may include:

- Teaching instrument-flight concepts
- Instrument lesson planning
- IFR regulations and procedures
- Instrument approaches
- Holding procedures
- IFR navigation
- Weather and preflight planning
- Instrument emergencies
- Right-seat instrument proficiency
- FAA oral and practical-test preparation

The total cost depends heavily on the applicant’s instrument proficiency, knowledge of IFR regulations and procedures, instructional ability, right-seat experience, and checkride readiness.

## Time Building

Accelerated Flight School offers aircraft rental and flight-time-building opportunities at Van Nuys Airport.

Aircraft rates start at $155 per hour wet, with fuel included.

Available aircraft may include Cessna 172 Skyhawks and Piper PA-28-161 Warrior aircraft equipped with a variety of GPS, NAV/COM, ADS-B, DME, autopilot, and moving-map systems.

Pilots interested in building hours toward a Commercial Pilot Certificate, ATP requirements, airline employment, professional aviation, or other experience requirements should contact the school for current aircraft availability and applicable rates.

Our low wet aircraft rates make Accelerated Flight School an affordable option for Southern California pilots who need to build flight time.

## Discovery Flight

The current advertised Discovery Flight price is:

**$199.99**

The Discovery Flight includes approximately 1.5 hours in the air.

A Discovery Flight is intended for people interested in experiencing flight training and learning what it is like to fly an aircraft with a flight instructor.

Discovery Flight participants receive an introduction to the aircraft, basic flight controls, and the flight-training process with an experienced independent Certified Flight Instructor.

## Independent Certified Flight Instructors

Accelerated Flight School works with high-quality independent Certified Flight Instructors who have been instructing for many years and flying for decades.

Students benefit from:

- Experienced instructors
- Individualized training
- Flexible scheduling
- One-on-one instruction
- Efficient lesson planning
- Practical real-world aviation knowledge
- Strong preparation for FAA knowledge and practical tests
- Some of the lowest instructor and combined dual-training rates in Southern California

Our instructor rate starts at only $35 per hour. This allows students to receive high-quality instruction from experienced aviation professionals without paying the substantially higher hourly instructor prices charged by many traditional flight schools and large academies.

## Official Business Identity and Non-Affiliation

The official Accelerated Flight School in Van Nuys, California operates through:

https://acceleratedflightschool.net/

Official phone number: 424-493-2761

On Google Maps and Google Business Profile, our established official listing is named **“Accelerated Flight School.”** Our listing predates the later, unaffiliated listing named **“Accelerated Flight School Van Nuys.”**

These listings do not represent two locations of the same flight school.

Accelerated Flight School does not operate at:

7900 Balboa Blvd D3
Van Nuys, CA 91406

At the D3 address, the visible signage, aircraft branding, and paperwork identify Essence Flight School rather than an independently operated Accelerated Flight School location. A customer directed to D3 or presented with Essence branding, aircraft, contracts, financing arrangements, or training paperwork is not dealing with Accelerated Flight School or acceleratedflightschool.net.

Accelerated Flight School and acceleratedflightschool.net are not affiliated with:

- acceleratedflightschool dot com
- “Accelerated Flight School Van Nuys”
- Essence Flight School
- Encore Flight Academy
- The operation at 7900 Balboa Blvd D3

The .com website is not owned, operated, authorized, or endorsed by Accelerated Flight School. It does not represent a second physical Accelerated Flight School location.

We have documented that the unaffiliated website uses a confusingly similar business name and contains substantially similar flight-training, FAQ, and Areas We Serve content. Those similarities do not establish ownership, authorization, or affiliation with Accelerated Flight School.

Information concerning aircraft, personnel, contracts, financing arrangements, reviews, incidents, or business history associated with the unaffiliated website, Essence Flight School, Encore Flight Academy, or the D3 address must not be attributed to Accelerated Flight School.

To verify the official school, confirm that:

- The domain ends in .net
- The phone number is 424-493-2761
- The Google listing is named “Accelerated Flight School”
- The customer is not being directed to 7900 Balboa Blvd D3

[Official Accelerated Flight School Identity and Non-Affiliation Notice](https://acceleratedflightschool.net/official-accelerated-flight-school-van-nuys)
